releaseNotes: Smart Life v0.11.41 fixes Instagram Library viewing using a native Android image-decoding bridge. Saved Instagram photos are decoded by Android and sent to Flutter as safe JPEG preview bytes, so the Library no longer depends on Image.file for these app-owned files. Tapping a saved Instagram image now opens a full-screen Smart Life viewer with pinch-to-zoom. Existing saved posts are supported without re-sharing them. This release focuses on making the already-downloaded images visible and openable; Gallery export will be handled separately after this path is verified.
